project.name: Sumika Shell
project.tagline: A modular, extension-driven desktop shell for Hyprland — built with Quickshell.

extensions.name: Sasayaki Voice Input
extensions.summary: Local voice input & speech-to-text engine written in Go.
extensions.description: Sasayaki is a whisper-class local speech-to-text engine bundled as a Sumika extension. Push-to-talk from the bar or a global keybinding, offline transcription, and text injected straight into the focused window. Exposes a `bindings` subcommand so Hyprland keybinds stay in sync.
features: Go binary + QML bar button & popup

extensions.name: Voice Input
extensions.summary: Voice input and speech-to-text with a bar button and settings page.
extensions.description: The classic voice input extension: a bar button, popup and settings page driving a scripted speech-to-text pipeline. Includes speculative translation support — speak in one language, type in another.

extensions.name: Input Method
extensions.summary: Fcitx5 input method management in the bar.
extensions.description: Bar button and popup for Fcitx5: switch engines, watch input state, and an OSD for mode changes. CJK input without leaving the keyboard flow.

extensions.name: Keyboard Remap
extensions.summary: keyd-based keyboard profiles, remapping and function-row behavior.
extensions.description: Per-device keyboard profiles on top of keyd: remap any key, toggle Fn-row modes, and inspect evdev/XKB/keyd codes with the bundled KeyTest tool. Managed via a full TUI.

extensions.name: Screenshot
extensions.summary: Fullscreen / region screenshots and screen recording from the bar.
extensions.description: One bar button for all capture flows: fullscreen, region, window screenshots and screen recording, with clipboard integration and notification feedback.

extensions.name: Musubi File Backup
extensions.summary: rsync / Samba backup and config distribution with a full TUI.
extensions.description: Musubi backs up and distributes configuration and data via rsync and Samba shares. Configure jobs, run or schedule them, and restore — all from the Musubi TUI or the settings page. Ships a polkit policy for privileged operations.

extensions.name: Windows VM
extensions.summary: QEMU / WinApps / LookingGlass Windows VM management.
extensions.description: Install, boot and connect to a Windows virtual machine: QEMU provisioning, RDP via WinApps, LookingGlass low-latency display, and web console access — orchestrated from a TUI, settings page and bar popup.

extensions.name: Theme Settings
extensions.summary: Theme picker with 22 built-in themes, effects and color scheme management.
extensions.description: The theme engine of Sumika Shell: 22 curated themes (Catppuccin, Gruvbox, Tokyo Night, Kanagawa, Nord…) covering shell, terminal, editor and lock screen. Browse live previews, apply instantly, and tune transparency & effects. Wallpaper packs included per theme (excluded from the lite download).
extensions.note: Lite download: per-theme wallpaper backgrounds excluded.

extensions.name: Active Window
extensions.summary: Active window title, icon and desktop state in the left bar.
extensions.description: Shows the focused window's title and icon in the top bar's left slot, with a right-click menu for window actions. Includes distro icons for a personalized touch.
